verdict.rationale: Canny publishes an API reference page at developers.canny.io/api-reference, but the evidence shows only the page title and says nothing about interactivity or runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, so there is no machine-readable spec that would typically power an interactive explorer. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable or copyable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
